description: This file defines the implementation of the EventBuffer class, which manages a buffer of input events, allowing addition of events with specific type, code, and value, and reserves space for a number of events.

classes.name: EventBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a buffer of input events, allowing addition and reservation of events.

methods.name: EventBuffer::EventBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that reserves space for a specified number of events in the buffer.

methods.name: EventBuffer::AddEvent
methods.description: Adds an input event with specified type, code, and value to the buffer.
